parameters.content:
## Registro fiable de alumnos

1. Webhook firmado (HMAC).
2. Valida email + curso.
3. Upsert en Postgres con UNIQUE(email, course_id).
4. HubSpot y email **no bloquean** la matrícula.
5. Si este workflow falla, el error workflow guarda `failed_enrollments`.

La app Next.js ya persistió en D1 antes de llamar.

parameters.query: SELECT id, student_id, status FROM course_enrollments WHERE lower(email) = lower($1) AND course_id = $2 LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO students (id, email, first_name, last_name, phone, current_level, marketing_consent, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NOW(), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
  last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
  phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, students.phone),
  current_level = EXCLUDED.current_level,
  marketing_consent = EXCLUDED.marketing_consent,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, email;

INSERT INTO course_enrollments (id, student_id, email, course_id, status, source, created_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, 'confirmed', $5, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (email, course_id) DO UPDATE SET status = course_enrollments.status
RETURNING id, student_id, email, course_id, status;
